assay: Affymetrix Human Genome U133 Plus 2.0 Array (GPL570)
biological_unit: one laser-microdissected macrophage-rich plaque region from one patient

filtering.criterion: absent call in at most 6 of 11 samples; external AFFX controls removed

testing.unit: gene after averaging unambiguous probes on log2 scale
testing.method: limma moderated linear model, trend=TRUE, robust=TRUE
